AC-0063 — Options > Gameplay: toggle hunger off — RESULTS

Summary: new persisted setting hunger_enabled (default true) in autoload/settings.gd; drain (sprint/mine/attack) and starve gated off when the setting is off; when off the hunger value is pinned to 20 every physics frame (bar renders full; regen rule unchanged since hunger>18); ON path is byte-identical (no tuning numbers touched). Options panel gains a Gameplay section + Hunger checkbox (same style as Fullscreen), centered-column layout untouched. Saved on toggle via the OPTSYNC plumbing; web persistence via the existing user://→IndexedDB path (same mechanism as AC-0062 saves).

Deviations / notes

  • Spec suggested extending AWeCRAFT_LOGIC=survival; I added a dedicated AWeCRAFT_LOGIC=hunger instead (survival harness left byte-identical and green) — same coverage, lower regression risk.
  • Web persistence: verified empirically (checkbox state survives reload + cfg file present in IndexedDB /userfs). Read-back of the raw cfg bytes proved unreliable in headless Chromium (IDBFS lazy-persist timing / GC of the read promise) — the reload-behavior proof is the gate-relevant one, and it passed deterministically (2/2 full runs: off after reload, OPTSYNC flipped true→false).
  • Web spawn takes ~2–3 min under swiftshader software rasterization (pre-existing; world-load cost, not this change) — G5 script budgets for it.
  • First G4 attempt wrote the PNG to a relative path (engine CWD = godot/) → re-ran with absolute path; no code impact.
